from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its title and formal cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document as referenced in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The formal cause of action (案由) stated in the document, e.g., '用益物权纠纷'")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., '民事判决书', '行政裁定书')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
